newReleases.name: Tideward
newReleases.desc:
Tideward is a peaceful idle RPG built for iPhone and iPad, and the rest of the Apple ecosystem you already own. Train 28 skills at your own pace, fight monsters, craft your own gear, and grow stronger even while you sleep.

No ads. No tracking. No third-party SDKs. One purchase, every device.


· TRUE OFFLINE PROGRESSION ·

Close the app and live your life. Manu Idle gives you up to 24 hours of full-speed progress every time you return. No throttling. No "watch an ad to claim." No daily-login guilt. Your character keeps working while you don't.


· 28 SKILLS, FOUR DISCIPLINES ·

Combat: eight skills covering melee, ranged, magic, faith-based buffs, vitality, defence, and a gated monster-task progression that opens up the late-game dungeons.

Gathering: woodcutting, fishing, mining, farming, and the careful art of pilfering from unsuspecting traders.

Artisan: smelt and forge gear at the anvil, cook your catch, kindle fires, scribe runes for spells, mix herbs into potions, and craft arrows, jewelry, and leather goods.

Support: wayfaring obstacle courses for movement bonuses, stargazing for passive buffs, and binding familiars, from the bear to the dragon, to fight at your side.

Every system feeds the others. Mine ore, smelt it into bars, forge a blade, take it into a dungeon. The depth of an MMO at the patience of an idle game.


· NATIVE ON EVERY APPLE DEVICE ·

Built in pure SwiftUI from the ground up. Not a web wrapper, not a port. Designed for each form factor:

• iPhone

newReleases.name: Lost Team: Wild Quest
newReleases.desc:
A wrong turn leads a coach and his team deep into the wild. Now the players are trapped, and there is only one way to bring them home.

Take control of the coach and face a series of challenges across a mysterious tribal forest. Explore the environment, control the ball, overcome obstacles, discover the right paths, and prove yourself through every challenge.

With every victory, another teammate gets one step closer to freedom.

Explore. Challenge. Rescue.

Move through the wild, master your controls, overcome different obstacles, and keep pushing forward as you work to reunite your team.

Every challenge brings you closer to the players waiting to be rescued. Use your skills, stay focused, and find your way through the forest.

Can you complete the journey and bring your team home?

newReleases.name: Tap Tap Arrow Defense Escape
newReleases.desc: Guide colorful arrows through a clever maze of paths, turns, and surprises in Tap Tap Arrow Defense Escape. Tap at the right moment, follow the changing routes, and find the perfect way forward. Each level brings a fresh puzzle that tests your timing, focus, and quick thinking. Easy to learn, satisfying to master, and fun for short sessions or longer challenges. Can you discover the right path and complete every level.

newReleases.name: Mendazzle
newReleases.desc:
Give damaged phones, cases and gadgets a fresh start in Mendazzle. Remove dirt, repair broken parts and complete each transformation with colors, patterns, stickers and decorative details.

Every item offers something different. Clean and polish worn technology, restore damaged phones or create a new look for a phone case. Simple tap, drag and swipe controls make each step easy to enjoy.

Relax with satisfying ASMR sounds as you wipe, scrub, fix, paint and decorate. Play at your own pace, then enjoy the final reveal as neglected tech becomes clean, restored and stylish.

Features:
Cleaning and restoration activities
Hands-on repair challenges
Creative case customization
Different gadgets to transform
Satisfying sounds and touch interactions
Rewarding before-and-after reveals

Clean the mess, repair the damage and create a fresh new look in Mendazzle!

newReleases.name: 9 Tiles Puzzle
newReleases.desc:
Turn any photo into a puzzle, then put it back together — your way.

9 Tiles Puzzle slices a picture into a grid and scrambles it. Fetch a fresh photo from the internet, snap one with your camera, dig into your own Photos library, or generate an abstract Numbers grid — then race, relax, or outsmart the fog to solve it.

SEVEN WAYS TO PLAY
• Slide — classic sliding-puzzle movement
• Swap — trade any two tiles, lock each one in as it lands
• Time Trial — beat the clock, or climb the 10-stage Gauntlet Ladder
• Limited Moves — solve within a strict move budget
• Zen — no timer, no streak pressure, just the puzzle
• Haze — tiles hide behind drifting fog; shake to peek
• Chaos — the source photo gets recolored, mirrored, or flipped before you even see it

DAILY CHALLENGE
One seeded puzzle every day, the same for everyone. A calendar tracks your streak and lets you replay any past day.

TRACK EVERY RECORD
• Stats — personal bests and games played, by grid size and mode
• Achievements — dozens of unlockable badges across six categories
• Wall of Fame — a cork board of your best moves, times, and streaks, each card with its own swing physics
• Game Center — leaderboards and your player profile

ALWAYS WITH YOU
A Live Activity tracks your in-progress puzzle on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. Three home-screen widgets — Daily Challenge, Streaks & Records, and Resume Game — get you back into the game in one tap.

FREE TO PLAY
Slide mode and the Daily Challenge are free, foreve

newReleases.name: WatchPals: Wrist Companion
newReleases.desc:
Meet the tiny friend who lives right on your wrist.

WatchPal is a watchOS-exclusive virtual pet game inspired by the simple charm of 1990s pocket pets. Raise one creature through quick moments of care throughout your day. Feed it, play together, clean its room, give medicine when it is sick, and tuck it in when it gets sleepy.

Your care shapes who your pal becomes. Its needs, temperament, and care history influence its evolution into one of several distinct pixel creatures. As your pet grows, you will unlock cozy rooms and tiny accessories that stay with your family across generations.

MADE FOR APPLE WATCH

• Turn the Digital Crown to hatch your egg, choose food, clean, and play
• Feel every interaction through carefully tuned haptics
• Check your pet from complications and Smart Stack widgets
• Play entirely on Apple Watch, with no iPhone companion

A SIMPLE LITTLE LIFE

• Hunger, joy, energy, cleanliness, and health
• Baby, child, teen, adult, and elder life stages
• Multiple evolution paths shaped by care and temperament
• Gentle life mode or classic death
• Four room themes and five wearable accessories
• A family album that remembers previous pets
• Relaxed care pacing, quiet hours, and vacation pause

WatchPal is a complete premium game. There are no ads, subscriptions, gacha, daily login rewards, battle passes, or paid currencies. Just you and a tiny pixel friend living on your wrist.

newReleases.name: Corto: Geography Map Game
newReleases.desc:
Corto puts your geography knowledge on the clock.

A place appears. Tap where it is on the world map, as fast and as accurately as you can. Every question scores up to 1,000 points: 800 for accuracy, 200 for speed. Ten questions, 10,000 possible. Getting close takes real knowledge of the world.

Start free with World Cities and ten learning packs, then unlock 164 themed packs: capitals and cities, flags and airport codes, volcanoes, stadiums, world wonders, remote islands. Each pack is a new way to test what you actually know.

Every pack is a lifetime purchase. Buy it once and it is yours, restorable on any device you sign in with. Corto has no subscriptions and no ads.

Think you're quick? Challenge a friend head-to-head. Trade turns, match their score, and settle it on the map. They don't need to own the pack: your copy covers the whole match.

Your best scores go to the Game Center leaderboards: one world ranking and nine category boards.

Beat your best, and learn the world without noticing.

Simple to learn. Hard to master. Endlessly replayable.

newReleases.name: Aristeu Game
newReleases.desc:
Ajude o Aristeu, o mascote da Kikoautos, a juntar as peças espalhadas pela loja antes que o tempo acabe!

Corra pela loja inteira em 3D, no estilo de blocos: a área das motos, a recepção, o café, o estúdio de podcast, a lojinha, o jardim, os pátios, o estúdio de fotos, a área de recarga, a Kdetail, o Car Wash e agora o escritório no 2º andar. Uma setinha mostra o caminho até a peça mais próxima.

SEIS NÍVEIS DE DESAFIO
• Nível 1: explore a loja com calma e aprenda os controles.
• Níveis 2 e 3: carros no pátio, consultores de moto, o jato de água do lavador, a fotógrafa com o flash, o carregador que dá choque e a loja cheia de clientes!
• Níveis 4 a 6: suba a escada para o escritório, desvie das cadeiras de rodinha, das calculadoras da Fernanda, das bombas de desenho do chefe e da papelada das impressoras. O nível 5 é de noite, com lanterna!

MONTE O SEU ARISTEU
Ganhe moedas e caixas surpresa jogando e escolha roupas, bonés, óculos, mochilas, danças e rastros. Tudo grátis, sem compras.

RANKING E CONQUISTAS
Bata seus recordes, dispute o ranking com o mundo e com os amigos no Game Center e desbloqueie conquistas. Seu progresso fica salvo no iCloud.

FÁCIL DE JOGAR
Toque e arraste para andar e pule por cima de motos, mesas e balcões. Feito para crianças, com partidas rápidas, música animada e botão para desligar o som.

SEGURO PARA CRIANÇAS
Sem anúncios, sem compras e sem cadastro. Não coletamos nenhum dado.

newReleases.name: SketchBot Duel
newReleases.desc:
Can you outsmart SketchBot?

SketchBot Duel is a fast drawing challenge where every line matters. Choose a prompt, race to sketch it, and let the AI referee decide whether your drawing truly matches. Random scribbles and unrelated drawings will not fool it.

HOW TO PLAY
• Choose one of several drawing prompts
• Draw before the round ends
• Submit your sketch to the AI referee
• Earn points for clear, recognizable drawings
• Complete three quick rounds and chase a better score

BUILT FOR QUICK FUN
No account and no long setup. Open the app and start drawing. Easy, Medium, and Hard prompt sets keep every match fresh.

FAIR AI SCORING
SketchBot checks the drawing that is actually visible on the canvas. Low-effort marks, written answers, and unrelated pictures are rejected, so good drawings earn their points.

PLAY FREE OR UNLOCK PRO
Play a daily set of solo games for free. A single lifetime Pro purchase unlocks unlimited solo games, Hard mode, and every current and future word pack.

Features:
• Fast three-round drawing matches
• A large variety of prompts
• AI-powered drawing recognition
• Clear feedback after every submission
• No account required
• One-time Pro upgrade—no subscription

newReleases.name: Paper Spurs
newReleases.desc:
A storm scattered the hens from the farm. You play the Leghorn: you wake up alone in the middle of the woods with one idea in your head — find the others and get home.

But by the time you make it back, the henhouse will already have a new owner.

A PAPER PLATFORMER
Everything you see is drawn as cut paper: the hens, the critters, the trees, even the hits, which burst into confetti. Four worlds with their own light and mood: the woods, the long road, the farm and the henhouse.

SEVEN HENS, SEVEN WAYS THROUGH
Every hen you rescue does something the others can't, and that's the game: the Silkie glides and bounces off thorns, the Brahma smashes what others dodge, the Araucana runs fast enough to tear through the bramble, the Sussex spins like a whirlwind and shreds the briars. You switch between them on the move, no pauses, and the path that wasn't there appears.

And the Rhode Island Red rooster kicks with both spurs, fighting-cock style.

24 LEVELS, 24 FIGHTS
Every level hides a mini-boss with its own arena and its own habits, and at the end of each world one is waiting: the Old Fox, the Road Dog, the Barn Cat and, deep inside the henhouse, the Stranger Rooster.

Hits chain together: one, two, and a finisher that leaps over and comes down hard. The chain grows as you go.

100% IS YOUR OWN BUSINESS
You can finish the whole game without picking up a single extra ear of corn. Clearing a level at 100% opens no doors: it's a challenge for whoever wants it, and the map remembers how

newReleases.name: STOPGAP
newReleases.desc:
The orb wants out. Keep it in.

An orb of living light is trapped beneath the stone. If it escapes, it's lights out for everyone. You've been put in charge of the lid.

Tap to stop each spinning stone over its matching hole. Line it up and it drops in. Fast, precise stops score more. As you climb, the holes start moving and the clock starts running. Miss too often and the orb wins.

Climb 50 rounds through five families of shapes, then keep going in endless play. Try the daily seal: one shared challenge, renewed each day. Collect the glyphs you seal and beat your best score.

FREE TO PLAY
Play dawn and gilt, the first 20 rounds, and the daily seal for free, as often as you like. One purchase unlocks the full game: ember, molten, corona, TOTALITY and endless play, on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV. If you downloaded STOPGAP before version 1.0.1, the full game is already yours.

Play offline. Game Center leaderboards are optional. No ads, ever. Music, effects, and haptics have separate settings.
newReleases.releaseNotes:
STOPGAP is now free to play.

• Dawn, gilt and the daily seal are free for everyone, as often as you like.
• One purchase unlocks the full game: ember, molten, corona, TOTALITY and endless play, on all your devices.
• Played version 1.0? The full game is already yours. Thank you for playing from the start.
• Small fixes and improvements.

newReleases.name: Mecca Gecko
newReleases.desc:
PAINT. HIDE. GET SPOTTED.

Mecca Gecko is a hide-and-seek party game for iPhone and iPad. Paint your character to match the scenery, freeze in a hiding pose, or copy a prop. When it is your turn to seek, search the room and tag hiders with a toy paint blaster.

HIDE AND PAINT
Turn your character into a living canvas. Sample colors and patterns from the room, paint your body, and blend into furniture, walls, and pictures. Crouch, curl into a ball, lie flat, or cling to a wall.

PROP HUNT
Copy an object in the map and hide among the real props. Seekers have to spot the difference.

RED VS BLUE
Play a team series, swapping hiding and seeking roles between rounds. Combine the series with Hide and Paint or Prop Hunt.

PLAY SOLO OR WITH FRIENDS
BOT PLAY lets you play offline with computer-controlled opponents. In PLAY ONLINE, host a party, share its code, or find an available game. Internet parties use an online relay; a player hosts the match. Players joining during a round enter as hiders.

MAKE YOUR CHARACTER YOURS
Choose from separate hider and seeker wardrobes. Hiders include the gecko, tabby, bunny, corgi, duck, and axolotl. Seekers include Chef, Cowboy, Detective, and other characters. Arrange an emote wheel and wave, dance, celebrate, or perform a backflip.

EXPLORE FOUR MAPS
Hide in Gecko House, Palm Cove, Castle Keep, and The Conservatory. The maps and core modes are included with the free game.

OPTIONAL PURCHASES
The shop offers characters, emotes, and consumable diamon

newReleases.name: かな食堂
newReleases.desc:
「かな食堂」は、落ちてくるひらがなを鍋に入れ、ことばを料理へ育てていく物理パズルゲームです。

かなの重さ、転がり方、ぶつかり方を見ながら位置を決め、読みがつながる文字を組み合わせましょう。「こめ」が「米」に、「にく」が「肉」になるように、正しい組み合わせから料理が生まれます。できた料理をさらに組み合わせると、新しい名物へ進化します。

【時間制限なしの一鍋勝負】
焦らず狙いを決めて、最高得点を目指せます。鍋の危険線を越え続けると閉店です。

【毎週変わるハイスコア鍋】
全プレイヤーに共通する条件でレシピが抽選されます。同じ条件の一鍋で、自分の最高記録に挑戦できます。

【全献立フィーバー鍋】
たくさんの料理と進化ルートを自由に試せるモードです。新しい組み合わせを探し、レシピ帳を埋めていきましょう。

【料理を助ける鍋の技】
料理を完成させると、鍋底への固定や圧縮、合体の引き寄せなどの技を獲得できます。爆破、強揺、換字の道具を使うタイミングも重要です。

【ゲストのまますぐ遊べる】
アカウントを作成しなくても、すべての核心的なゲーム機能を楽しめます。ログインすると週間ランキングや端末間同期を利用できます。

小さな「かな」を重ねて、あなただけの名物を育てましょう。

newReleases.name: mySudoku: Learn & Play
newReleases.desc:
mySudoku is Sudoku for people who want to get better at it.

Every puzzle has exactly one solution and is rated by the solving technique it needs, not by how many clues it shows. Beginner puzzles fall to singles; Expert puzzles need Swordfish, Y-Wing or coloring. You always know what a level asks of you.

HINTS THAT TEACH
A hint never just fills in a cell. It names the technique first, then shows you where to look, then explains why, and only places the digit if you ask. Hints are limited per level, so they stay a lesson rather than a crutch.

LEARN THE TECHNIQUES
Twelve techniques, from Naked Single to Simple Coloring, each with an interactive lesson on a real board. Watch the step unfold, try the position yourself, or generate a fresh puzzle that needs exactly that technique. Statistics keeps track of which techniques you spot on your own.

DAILY CHALLENGE
The same Medium puzzle for everyone, every day, with a calendar of past days, a medal for every solve, a trophy for a complete month and a daily leaderboard.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Pencil marks, Snyder notation and candidate colouring in five colours
• Cell-first or digit-first input
• Highlight matching digits and conflicts, optional auto-check
• Relaxed Mode: hide the timer, set your own mistake limit or none at all
• Undo, redo, pause, reset
• Sounds and haptics, each with its own switch

On the Mac: full keyboard control, menu commands, printing, and a menu bar puzzle that is always one click away.

STATISTICS AND GAME CENT

newReleases.name: Anomaly: Logic Puzzles
newReleases.desc:
Something aboard is off.

Anomaly is a deduction puzzle in the tradition of Einstein's riddle, dressed as a mystery on a research station in orbit. One grid, a log full of gaps, exactly one solution — and no luck involved.

NEVER A GUESS
Every case is built so that each step can be forced. There is exactly one solution, and a path to it that needs no trial and error. If you are stuck, you have missed something — you have not been unlucky.

SIX DIFFICULTIES
From introductory to extreme. The next one opens once you have solved three cases of the current level, at least one of them without a hint. Grids grow from 3×3 to 6×5.

DAILY PUZZLE
One case a day for everyone, with its own streak. The week is a ramp: easy on Monday, extreme on Sunday. It is never locked — full version or not.

HINTS THAT EXPLAIN
Three stages: which log entry carries now, which cell follows from it, and finally filling it in. You pay for the look, not for the depth. Hints come from three pools — a daily allowance, the credit that solved cases earn, and purchased packs. They are spent top down: first what expires anyway, last what cost money.

CONSISTENCY CHECK
Is there a contradiction anywhere? The answer is exact — and limited for exactly that reason, with a cooldown instead of endless asking.

BILINGUAL AND ACCESSIBLE
German and English. Dynamic Type up to the accessibility sizes, VoiceOver with spoken forms of every condensed value.

WHAT THE GAME IS NOT
• No advertising, no tracking, no analytics, no a

newReleases.name: Arrow Sort – Color Rush
newReleases.desc:
One tap and the arrow flies – but only if the path is clear! Arrow Sort is the perfect puzzle for any spare moment: easy to learn, hard to master.

HOW IT WORKS
Colorful arrows are tangled across the board. Tap an arrow and it flies off in its direction – as long as nothing blocks its way. Every arrow you free lands in your tray, and three of the same color disappear. But watch out: the tray only has five slots. Tap without a plan and you'll get stuck fast.

THREE STARS FOR TRUE PROS
Winning is one thing. For three stars you need to sort cleanly: one color at a time, no mix-ups in the tray, no helpers and on your first try. Every level is guaranteed to be perfectly solvable – no luck required.

200 LEVELS FULL OF SURPRISES
- A relaxed start that gets trickier step by step
- Hidden arrows that only reveal their color once they're free
- Ice arrows that thaw after a few moves
- Bomb arrows you have to clear in time
- Boss levels for those who want a real challenge

COMBOS AND BLITZ
Clear matches in quick succession to trigger combos. They charge your Blitz: it completes a color match in one strike and pulls the arrows it needs off the board, no matter how deeply they're buried.

RUSH MODE
No breaks, no breathing room: in Rush, new arrows keep pouring onto the board, faster and faster. How long can you last? Chase your high score and compete with players worldwide on the Game Center leaderboard.

DAILY CHALLENGE
A new puzzle every day. Keep going, build your streak and track you

newReleases.name: Ashen Road
newReleases.desc:
They came at dusk, when the moon hung low and red. By dawn the caravan was ash, and Tarn's kin were gone east along the Ashen Road.

Ashen Road is a side-scrolling sword fight across a dying bronze-age frontier. Follow the captives one link of the chain at a time: through raider camps and ruined watchtowers, a drowned river town, a salt market where people are weighed like grain, burning grassland, a forest of bone and a mountain pass, to the oldest ruin under the moon, and home again.

BUILT FOR ONE THUMB AND A GLANCE
You move and choose the target; Tarn swings the sword. Drag anywhere to move, tap an enemy to go after it, flick to dodge, and hold still to wind up a spinning heavy strike. Nothing to memorise, and every fight rewards reading the enemy rather than tapping faster.

A STORY TOLD BETWEEN BLOWS
An old storyteller's voice narrates as you go, in short lines that never stop the fight. Nine chapters, each with its own place, its own enemies and its own task: light the signal fires, break the slave cages, topple the pyres.

- 9 hand-painted chapters
- Fully voiced narration with subtitles
- Original score
- Progress saved at checkpoints; replay any chapter you have reached

No account. No ads. No in-app purchases. No network: the game works entirely offline and nothing you do leaves the phone.

newReleases.name: Castlevania: 40th Anniversary
newReleases.desc:
The Castlevania game that started it all finally comes to mobile for a limited time.

□Story

In medieval Europe, the legend of Dracula is told in frightened whispers in the small country of Transylvania.

Once every century, the prayers of those with evil in their hearts shall resurrect the Dark Lord Dracula. Each time he returns, his dark powers grow stronger than the last.

One night there was a magnificent carnival being held in the bustling city. That night marked the 100th year anniversary of Dracula’s defeat at the hands of the hero Christopher Belmont.

Suddenly, the town was enveloped by dark storm clouds and a bolt of lightning rained down, signaling that Count Dracula and his evil ambitions had returned to the world yet again.

With the Belmont blood running though his veins, the young Vampire Hunter Simon knew that only he could face this evil. Taking up the whip enchanted with miraculous power given to him by his father, Simon hastened towards Dracula’s castle on his own.

□Features

The deep rich Castlevania history that began with this original game.

The fated confrontation between Dracula and unforgettable action hero Simon Belmont that played out with a horrific twist groundbreaking for its time.

The dark vast world of Castlevania that canonized the iconic whip-wielding character moves of Simon Belmont and the classic music tracks.

Intense hard-to-beat action platformer that inspired a long-running and beloved franchise.

Direct port of the original title

newReleases.name: Aniimo
newReleases.desc:
Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. On the vast continent of Idyll, you'll encounter countless unique creatures known as Aniimo. Twine with them and experience the beauty of this world from a completely new perspective and with new abilities.
You can also travel to a metropolis floating in the sky, where you'll meet other Pathfinders, share stories, and engage in thrilling competitive battles. Choose your Aniimo and embark on an epic journey - one full of exploration, discovery, and adventure!

Seize every chance to capture and collect Aniimo to your heart's desire! 

When embarking on an adventure on Idyll, anyone you meet can become a companion! Catch Aniimo using Aniipods, set traps and time your catch perfectly - enjoy the thrill and uncertainty of every moment! Unique Aniimo will appear according to the environment, weather, phenomena and time of day. Most Aniimo can evolve, making collecting and discovering Aniimo even more exciting.

Twine with Aniimo to feel the world like they do

On your journey of adventure you can Twine with Aniimo and essentially become any Aniimo that you collect. Use the Aniimo’s skills to solve puzzles, win battles and overcome challenges! Twine with Aniimo, to see the world from a brand new perspective.

Jump into the adventure and enjoy exploring an expansive open world

newReleases.name: Jam Bus:Sandfall
newReleases.desc:
Clear colorful sand with buses, plan each route, and avoid every crash.Tap the right bus, clear the sand, and escape the traffic jam.

Jam Bus: Sandfall brings a fresh twist to bus jam, color puzzle, and traffic escape gameplay.
Colorful sand is stacked in layers, and every bus has its own color and direction. Tap the right bus, collect the matching sand, and clear the board step by step. Sounds simple at first, but every move can change the whole puzzle.
Plan carefully before you tap. Some buses may block each other. Some paths may cross. Some sand colors can only be cleared after the lower layers are gone. To win, you need to observe the board, choose the right order, and keep every bus moving without a crash.
How to play
• Tap a bus to move it along its route
 • Match each bus with the same color sand
 • Clear lower sand layers to unlock the ones above
 • Avoid traffic crashes when paths cross
 • Solve each level with smart sequencing
Why you’ll enjoy Jam Bus: Sandfall
• Easy tap controls
 • Relaxing color-matching gameplay
 • Clever bus parking jam puzzles
 • Satisfying sand-clearing effects
 • Increasingly tricky routes and layers
 • Clean visuals and smooth puzzle flow
 • Great for quick breaks and brain training

newReleases.name: Songless: Guess the Song!
newReleases.desc:
Discover how well you really know your music with SONGLESS. Guess the song, explore genres you love, challenge yourself with different difficulty levels, and see how your instincts stack up round after round.

SONGLESS helps you test and sharpen your music recognition, one song at a time.
SONGLESS uses a growing song library with adjustable difficulty, so both casual listeners and true music experts get a real challenge.
